findings.title: Federated rules are always treated as editable
findings.body: useAllAlertRuleAbilities now delegates to useAllRulerRuleAbilities, which hardcodes isFederated to false (the old isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) check is gone, and RuleGroupIdentifierV2 cannot express source_tenants). Federated Mimir/GEM groups were previously immutable. Every consumer of useAlertRuleAbility / useAllAlertRuleAbilities will now offer edit, delete, pause, and duplicate on federated rules.

findings.title: Delete is unreachable in the ruler-free list view
findings.body: canDelete can be true from useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities when only a Prometheus rule is loaded, but the Delete item is still rendered only when rulerRule is defined, and onClick passes that rulerRule to handleDelete. GrafanaRuleListItem never supplies a ruler rule, and RuleActionsButtons already deletes via the identifier (showDeleteModal(identifier, groupIdentifier)), so the extra guard hides Delete for every Grafana rule in the new list. The group-loader menu test even asserts only four items and never looks for Delete despite granting AlertingRuleDelete.

findings.title: Pause never appears without a ruler rule
findings.body: canPause is OR-ed with the Prometheus-rule ability so the list view can authorize pause without the ruler API, but the menu item is still gated on rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule) and MenuItemPauseRule requires a RulerGrafanaRuleDTO. In the new list, rulerRule is undefined, so Pause is never shown even for users who can edit the rule.

findings.title: Silence action opens nothing in the list view
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu can show Silence notifications from Prometheus-rule abilities and calls handleSilence, which only sets showSilenceDrawer. The drawer is rendered only when rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) is true. List items pass promRule and no ruler rule, so the click sets state and then renders nothing.

findings.title: Recording-rule export and pause dropped
findings.body: useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities sets ModifyExport, Pause, Restore, and DeletePermanently supported only when prometheusRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) is true. The ruler path used rulerRuleType.grafana.rule, which includes Grafana recording rules. Recording rules in the list therefore lose export and pause/restore even when the user has folder edit permission and the rule is not provisioned.

findings.title: Filtered Grafana rows are rendered without a key
findings.body: The grafana branch of rules.map used to pass key={key} into GrafanaRuleLoader. GrafanaRuleListItem is now returned with no key, while the datasource and unknown branches still set one. As pages append, React will reuse the wrong row instances, so action menus, links, and pause/health state can attach to the wrong rule.

findings.title: Rule view links drop returnTo
findings.body: The removed GrafanaRuleListItem built the view href with createReturnTo() so the detail page could navigate back to the current list URL (including filters). The replacement always links to /alerting/grafana/${uid}/view with no returnTo query. Opening a rule from the list no longer restores the filtered list on back navigation.
